description: This file defines the Java interface 'AmqpEndpoint' which specifies methods for handling AMQP link attachment requests and connection closures in a messaging service context.

classes.name: AmqpEndpoint
classes.description: Interface defining AMQP endpoint behaviors for establishing links and handling connection lifecycle events.

methods.name: onLinkAttach
methods.description: Handles a client's request to establish a link for sending or receiving messages via AMQP, with different overloads for sender and receiver.

methods.name: onConnectionClosed
methods.description: Handles cleanup or other actions when an AMQP connection is closed.
